title: The change skipped spec deltas although it changes a Docker image and adds a test, not only docs
resolution: Removed skip_specs and added the native-worker-acceptance requirement that the Linux test image of the crash-window and G2 suites provides the worker's pinned Git client; the delta validates strictly and archives cleanly in a scratch copy.

title: The Git pin agreement test matched literal text, so a commented-out check passed and extra spaces failed
resolution: The test reads the instructions of the worker stage and the test image's last stage, without comment lines and with continuations and whitespace normalized. Of its seven new cases, four failed against the old matching and all pass now.
